tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 10. Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills; do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT - three REAL defects isolated by the proof-ladder classifier (evidence in /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workLadderCls/gl-ladder-classify/CLASSIFICATION.md, section '# Real defects' - read it): (A) HIGH, mixed intent: with offers standing, a reply that both picks an opening AND asks about a different day was silently resolved into a new search; consent-sensitive - it must clarify once. Production v96 solved exactly this with the n_which_intent node (its stored config is in /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD4/capture-v96/graph.json - derive from it, do not invent). (B) MEDIUM, out-of-hours: a 3am request was answered with unrelated daytime offers; it must honestly say nothing is open at that hour (never inventing 3am slots) and may offer the nearest real time. The gateway is being extended IN PARALLEL (lane 41) to return a new availability result field out_of_hours (true/false) plus requested_clock whenever an after/before/anchor clock falls outside the day's real slot bounds - build against that contract. (C) MEDIUM, day-less clock time: 'a time like 3pm with no day' dead-ended asking for a day; the gateway (lane 41) now defaults an empty/none from/to to a standing today..+13 window, so the pathway must ROUTE such messages to the search rather than to a miss. SOURCE MATERIALS (read-only; copy into CWD then edit): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD10/gl-round9-fix/ has the round-9 draft (minted v105), validator (assertions 1-9), build scripts, frozen-extractors.json, fixtures. THE FIX, exactly: (1) MIXED-INTENT CLARIFY: add user-wait Default node n_mixed_intent, its patient-facing copy and behavior derived from stored v96 n_which_intent (adapted only for as-built variable names; template-verbatim any slot references; ONE clarify then act on the answer - never a second clarification, per the standing fail-open ruling). Edge from n_goal_response to n_mixed_intent labeled exactly 'both selects an opening and asks for a different day or time'. Outbound edges from n_mixed_intent: to n_gate_1 and n_gate_2 (patient confirms they want the offered opening, including by naming its clock time), to n_goal_search (patient states a new day/date/time preference), plus decline and 72-hour timeout edges to the existing end nodes. n_mixed_intent MUST carry the full frozen extractor set (copy frozen-extractors.json verbatim) because a clarify answer can state a new preference that flows directly to the search webhook. (2) OUT-OF-HOURS HONESTY: add to every availability search webhook's responseData the mappings out_of_hours from $.result.out_of_hours and requested_clock from $.result.requested_clock; extend the n_goal_response prompt with a branch: when out_of_hours is true, say there are no openings at the requested hour (reference {{requested_clock}}), offer the nearest real slots verbatim from the slot variables, and ask for another day or time - never state or imply availability at the requested out-of-hours clock. Prompt stays within 3,900 characters total. (3) TIME-ONLY ROUTING: extend the n_goal_response-to-n_goal_search edge label with ' - or gives only a time preference when no date has been offered yet' so pre-offer clock-only messages route to the search (the gateway's new default window makes that search succeed); the offered_time edge keeps its on-the-offered-date scope unchanged. (4) Everything else from rounds 6-9 is untouched: frozen-extractors.json copied byte-identical, five searches with their exact bodies, per-branch confirms, gate labels, all existing edges except where named above. (5) VALIDATOR: add ASSERTION 10 keeping 1-9 intact: n_mixed_intent exists as user-wait Default with the frozen extractors, the labeled edge from n_goal_response, and routes to both gates and n_goal_search; every availability webhook maps out_of_hours; the n_goal_response prompt contains the out_of_hours branch; the none-search edge label covers pre-offer time-only. Structured FAIL lines citing 'assertion 10'; PASS on success. Must PASS your draft and FAIL the untouched round-9 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD10/gl-round9-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json with an assertion citation. (6) build_goalloop.py regenerates everything deterministically; fixture-conformant.json passes all ten assertions. (7) DEBUG.md: the three defects with evidence, what changed, regeneration command; must mention n_which_intent derivation and the out_of_hours contract.
